ammonia.reason: Limited amino acid deamination and ureolysis in 60-d semi-hard with no surface flora

animal_barnyard.reason: Cow milk only, no sheep/goat markers; indole and p-cresol not detected

bitter.reason: Low accumulation of hydrophobic peptides from rennet/plasmin in short 60-d ripening

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti inoculation and no C7/C9/C11 methyl ketones reported

browning.reason: Moderate Maillard between residual lactose/galactose and lysine on heating

buttery.reason: Diacetyl mean 460 mg/kg and acetoin 15 mg/kg from citrate metabolism by Lactococcus starter

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Butyric acid mean 374 mg/kg from milk lipase and starter esterase lipolysis

creaminess.reason: Fat 21.9% fresh weight and moisture 48.5% gives smooth lubricating matrix

crumbliness.reason: Elastic rennet gel at pH ~5.3, lightly cooked and pressed, not dry-fracturing

firmness.reason: Semi-hard moisture 48.5% with light cooking to ~42-44C and pressing

floral_honey.reason: Low phenylalanine catabolism to phenylacetaldehyde/2-phenylethanol in short age

fruity.reason: Low esterase activity; only low ethyl acetate sweet note, no high ethyl butanoate/hexanoate

goaty.reason: Cow milk low in C6-C10 free fatty acids; iso-valeric only 140 mg/kg

malty_nutty.reason: Branched-chain amino acid Strecker catabolism plus propionic 455 mg/kg during 60-d ripening

melt.reason: Rennet curd pH ~5.3 with solubilized colloidal calcium flows on heating

mushroom_earthy.reason: No bloomy or washed rind mold; 1-octen-3-ol/1-octen-3-one linoleate pathway minimal

oil_off.reason: Moderate fat-in-dry-matter 42.5% stable emulsion with little free oil on heating

smoky.reason: Unsmoked cheese; guaiacol and phenols absent, no wood-smoke process

sour_vinegar.reason: Lactic acid mean 16.6 mg/g plus acetic 557 mg/kg from lactose fermentation

stretch.reason: Non-pasta-filata rennet gel with no hot-water kneading to align casein

sulfur_cooked.reason: Low methionine catabolism to methanethiol/DMDS and no high heat whey protein denaturation

sweet.reason: Residual lactose 3.0 mg/g galactose 1.4 mg/g plus diacetyl sweet note

umami.reason: Moderate glutamate release from rennet and plasmin proteolysis by 60 days
